stem:
Ananya wants to measure the length of her pencil using a scale.
Which method will give her the most accurate measurement?

options.text: Hold the scale above the pencil without touching it, and read the scale from an angle.
Place the scale along the pencil, read the scale with the eye directly above the end point, and write the number with its unit.
Place the scale along the pencil and write down only the number, as the unit does not matter.
Place the pencil beside the scale and guess the length by looking from the side.

teacher.key_rationale: Accurate scale measurement requires the scale in contact along the object, the eye directly above the end point to avoid parallax, and the reading reported with its unit. Only option B includes all three; A introduces eye-position and placement error, C omits the unit, D involves both angular viewing and guessing.
